title: A simple brace outside asymmetric products of two trivial braces
strongest_verified_result: The explicit brace of order20,000 is nontrivial and simple, with additive group C5^4 x C2^5 and multiplicative group (C5^3 semidirect_tau C2) x (C2^4 semidirect_M C5). Its multiplicative group is metabelian with all Sylow subgroups abelian. Its nonzero additive5-primary triple star excludes every brace-isomorphic presentation as an asymmetric product of two trivial left braces, including every admissible normalized symmetric-cocycle presentation.
proof_scope: Full ideal simplicity, using both lambda_g(i)-i and i*g closure, not only left-ideal closure.
Universal full-cocycle-to-bilinearity reduction and p-primary triple-star invariant, not finite sampling of products.
Additive p-primary need not split, including p=2.
No least-order or exhaustive classification theorem; no exclusion of more than two factors or nontrivial factors.
